_comment: Denylist for the embargo guard (scripts/embargo-guard.mjs), enforced by the
pre-commit + commit-msg hooks in .githooks/ and by the 'embargo' CI job.
Entries store a SALTED SHA-256 DIGEST of a forbidden token, never the token
itself, so this file is safe to keep on a public branch. The guard finds a
token by sliding a window of `length` over normalized content and comparing
digests -- it never needs the plaintext.
Normalization: lowercase, then delete every character outside [a-z0-9]. That
makes matching immune to case, spacing, punctuation and line wrapping, so
'Foo Bar', 'foo-bar', '**FooBar**' and a 'Foo\nBar' line break all collide.
To add a token without ever writing it to disk:
There is deliberately no allowlist or ignore-file: an exemption would just be
a second committed place the token lives.
